job.title: Property & Compliance Manager – Aged Care
job.description:
A leading Australian organisation operating within the aged care sector, providing high-quality care and support to older Australians across an established network of residential care homes. With a significant national property portfolio and a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement, the organisation is committed to creating environments where residents can feel at home and its people can thrive.

The Benefits

  • Up to $135,000 + Super
  • Hybrid working – 3 days in Sydney CBD
  • Significant and diverse property portfolio
  • Broad remit across contracts, compliance and asset management
  • Opportunity to influence processes and drive meaningful improvements
  • Work closely with senior property and asset management stakeholders
  • Join an established organisation within an essential and growing sector


The Role
This is a key role within the property function, responsible for supporting the effective management of property assets, contractor relationships, compliance requirements, maintenance programs and capital works. Key Responsibilities will include:

  • Manage property contracts, procurement and contractor performance
  • Plan and coordinate preventative and reactive maintenance programs
  • Oversee essential services compliance, including fire systems, lifts and other critical assets
  • Coordinate maintenance and capital works budgets, approvals and reporting
  • Support property audits, compliance reporting and accreditation requirements
  • Develop and improve asset management systems, processes and lifecycle strategies
  • Lead tenders and portfolio-wide property improvement initiatives
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders, contractors and external service providers


The Requirements

  • Strong experience in property services, facilities or asset management ideally within the Aged Care Industry (although not essential)
  • Strong experience in contract management, procurement and compliance
  • Sound knowledge of essential services compliance and relevant Australian Standards, including AS 1851-2012
  • Experience managing contractors, property audits, maintenance programs and risk
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Property, Construction, Management or a related discipline
  • Experience with ERP, WMS or CMMS Systems
  • Current driver's licence


If you feel you have all the skills above and looking to working for a leading Aged Care provider, please click apply now to forward an up-to-date copy of your resume. Alternatively email David Booth, david@maydaytechnical.com for a confidential conversation

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
Company: A global OEM specialising in high-speed automated packaging and processing equipment for the FMCG industry is expanding its Australian service team.
Supporting major food and beverage manufacturers across Australia and the wider APAC region, the business designs, installs, commissions and services highly automated production and packaging lines.
Due to continued growth, they are looking for an Electrical / Automation Service Technician to join their East Coast service team.

Benefits

  • Permanent full-time position
  • $15k vehicle allowance
  • Training held across Europe, Asia and the USA
  • Ongoing specialist automation and equipment training
  • Significant investment in your long-term technical development
  • Travel across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific region
  • Sydney, Brisbane or Melbourne based
  • Long-term career progression with a leading global OEM


Pay & Shift Structure

  • Base salary $95k–$115k ($50-$58 p/h) + super
  • Huge overtime earning potential
  • Day shift predominantly
  • Project work can involve 10-12 hour days
  • Work patterns vary around installations, servicing and scheduled customer projects


The Role: This is a field-based electrical and automation service position supporting high-speed FMCG production and packaging equipment.
Travel is a major part of the position, supporting customers across Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea and the Pacific Islands. Some projects can require you to be away from home for up to three weeks at a time.
Where possible, work will be scheduled within your home state, however you need to be comfortable with regular domestic and international travel.

Requirements

  • Qualified Electrician with electrical licence
  • Strong industrial electrical fault-finding experience
  • PLC fault finding and diagnostics
  • Experience working with automated machinery
  • FMCG, food, beverage pharmaceuticals or high-speed manufacturing experience
  • Previous OEM field service experience advantageous
  • Comfortable travelling and being away from home for up to 3 weeks
  • Keen to undertake international technical training
  • Looking to commit to a role for 3+ years and take advantage of the significant training, technical development and career progression the company invests in its technicians


For more information or a confidential discussion, apply now or contact maisy@maydaytechnical.com.

job.title: Afternoon Fitter
job.description:
This established heavy industrial company plays a key role in supplying essential materials into the construction, manufacturing and infrastructure sectors across NSW. Operating out of a large-scale processing facility in Blacktown, they offer stable long-term employment within a busy operation where maintenance reliability is critical to keeping production moving.
Benefits
• Permanent full-time role: Afternoon shift
• 6-day week: Monday – Friday 1pm–11:30pm | Saturday 1pm–6pm
• $50–$52 per hour depending on experience + 20% afternoon shift loading
• 4 weeks paid annual leave
• Strong safety culture and well-resourced maintenance team
• Busy, team-oriented workshop and production environment
Pay Rate / Salary Package
Based on the standard 56-hour working week, including 18 hours of overtime:

  • $50/hr: circa $182,000 + super annually
  • $52/hr: circa $189,000 + super annually


The Role
Working within the maintenance team, you'll play a key role in executing planned maintenance, equipment upgrades and reliability improvements across a busy industrial site. The role offers exposure across both heavy fixed plant and mobile plant equipment within a workshop and production environment.
Day to day you will be involved in:
• Preventative maintenance and planned maintenance activities across heavy plant and processing equipment
• Shutdown maintenance, equipment rebuilds and reliability improvement projects
• Installation and commissioning of new equipment and plant upgrades
• Fault finding, servicing and maintenance on heavy fixed plant and mobile plant equipment
• Supporting continuous improvement and plant reliability initiatives
• Workshop-based repairs, fabrication support and onsite maintenance activities
Requirements
• Trade qualified Mechanical Fitter
• Experience within heavy industry, recycling, manufacturing, mines or tunnels
• Strong preventative maintenance and reliability maintenance experience
• MIG & stick welding exposure highly regarded
• High Risk tickets highly desirable: EWP, Forklift & Confined Spaces

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
Company: A growing specialist in the installation, servicing and maintenance of commercial and industrial pump systems across NSW. Working across commercial buildings, shopping centres, supermarkets, petrol stations and industrial sites, they provide installation, breakdown and preventative maintenance services across pumps, motors, controls and associated equipment.
Due to continued growth, they are looking for a Service Technician with a Mechanical Fitting background, Disconnect/Reconnect and previous pump experience to join their small, experienced service team.

Benefits

  • Permanent Full-time role
  • Mon-Fri 7am-3:30pm
  • $50–$54 p/h depending on experience
  • STRAIGHT DOUBLE OVERTIME
  • OT Earning potential: $123k–$159k + super
  • Company vehicle, phone and uniform
  • Structured workshop and on-the-job pump training
  • Varied field service role across commercial and industrial sites
  • Small, growing team with long-term career opportunities
  • Opportunity to further develop your pump and electrical knowledge


The Role: This is a hands-on field service position with a strong mechanical focus, working across commercial and industrial pump systems throughout Sydney and NSW.
You'll primarily be responsible for the servicing, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment, while using your Disconnect/Reconnect capabilities to complete electrical work associated with motors and pump systems.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Servicing, repairing and rebuilding commercial and industrial pumps
  • Fault finding across pumps, motors and associated equipment
  • Removal, installation and replacement of pumps and electric motors
  • Working on bearings, seals, shafts, couplings and other mechanical components
  • Breakdown and preventative maintenance
  • Disconnecting and reconnecting motors and associated equipment
  • Basic electrical fault finding across motors and pump systems
  • Exposure to VSDs/VFDs, control panels and switches
  • Working autonomously across a variety of customer sites


Requirements

  • Trade qualified Mechanical Fitter / Fitter & Turner or similar
  • Disconnect/Reconnect licence or qualification
  • Previous hands-on experience servicing, repairing or maintaining pumps
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a field service environment
  • Full driver's licence
  • Able to pass a police check


Apply Now!

job.title: Talent Coordinator
job.description:
Talent Coordinator
CBD location | 6-month contract | Full-time | $40–$45 per hour + super | Hybrid work arrangements

  • 6-month Talent Coordinator contract in Melbourne CBD
  • $40–$45 per hour + super with 3 days WFH after onboarding
  • Support recruitment, interviews, onboarding and reference checks


About the company
We are currently seeking an experienced Talent Coordinator to join a busy Talent team on a 6-month contract.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the coordination and administration side of recruitment and is confident managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The company are based in Melbourne’s CBD. They offer hybrid work options, 3 days working from home and 2 days in the office. For the first month whilst onboarding you will be required in the office full-time.
This role is to start ASAP.

Key Responsibilities
Working closely with the Talent team, you will provide hands-on coordination and administrative support across the recruitment lifecycle. You will play an important role in keeping recruitment processes moving efficiently and ensuring a positive experience for candidates and hiring managers.

  • Coordinate recruitment activities across multiple vacancies and stakeholders
  • Support the onboarding process for new starters
  • Schedule and coordinate interviews
  • Complete recruitment administration and maintain accurate candidate records
  • Conduct and coordinate reference checks
  • Prepare documentation and support the Talent team with recruitment processes
  • Provide general coordination and administrative support during a busy period


About You:

  • Has experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment or HR coordination
  • Is highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Has strong attention to detail and excellent communication skills
  • Is confident coordinating interviews and working with multiple stakeholders
  • Enjoys working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Can hit the ground running and provide reliable support to a busy Talent function


Benefits:

  • 6-month full-time contract
  • $40–$45 per hour + super
  • CBD-based office | Close to public transport
  • Hybrid working: 2 days in the office and 3 days from home following onboarding
  • Opportunity to support an established Talent team during a particularly busy period
  • A varied role with exposure across recruitment coordination, onboarding and Talent administration

Please apply today with a copy of your resume.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, including people with disability, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and those from culturally diverse backgrounds.

job.title: Electrical Apprentice (3rd or 4th Year)
job.description:
The Company: Join one of Australia's largest overhead crane manufacturers and service providers, with a national footprint supporting customers across industrial sectors such as manufacturing, mining, ports, recycling, logistics and heavy industry.

Benefits:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Predominantly field-based & small amount in workshop
  • Industrial Specialisation: PLCs, VSDs, motors and crane control systems
  • Work across a wide variety of industrial sites and environments
  • Work 1:1 alongside experienced Electrical Tradespeople
  • Continued trade school support
  • Long-term pathway into an Electrical Crane Technician / Field Service role


Shift Structure & Pay:

  • Mon–Fri, 7:00am–3:30pm
  • Pay rate as per the applicable award
  • Overtime available: Usually 1–5 hours per week


The Role: Working alongside a qualified Electrical Tradesperson, you will predominantly be out in the field assisting with routine maintenance, repairs and upgrades to overhead cranes and lifting equipment. You will gain broad exposure to industrial electrical systems while completing your Certificate III in Electrotechnology and working towards your full electrical licence.

Duties include:

  • Assisting with routine electrical maintenance and servicing
  • Electrical fault finding and diagnostics
  • Repairs and upgrades to overhead cranes and lifting equipment
  • Working with electrical control panels and crane control systems
  • Exposure to PLCs and VSDs
  • Working with motors, contactors, switches and sensors
  • Testing and commissioning
  • Assisting with breakdown repairs


Requirements:

  • Currently completing Certificate III in Electrotechnology
  • 3rd or 4th Year Electrical Apprentice
  • Current Driver Licence
  • Reliable, safety-conscious and eager to learn
  • Industrial experience preferred but not essential – apprentices from construction or other electrical backgrounds are encouraged to apply


Apply Now! If you're a 3rd or 4th Year Electrical Apprentice looking to broaden your experience, move into industrial electrical maintenance and finish your apprenticeship with exposure to a wide variety of equipment and sites, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
Join one of Australia's largest overhead crane manufacturers and service providers, with a national footprint supporting customers across industrial sectors such as mining, ports, recycling, logistics and heavy industry.

Full training provided!

We welcome industrial electricians from other fields and industries who are interested in learning new skills!

Benefits


  • Permanent full-time position, Mon–Fri: 7:00am–3:30pm

  • $53–$58 per hour depending on experience

  • Company vehicle, fuel card + tolls

  • GUARANTEED OVERTIME

  • Work 50–55 hours per week and earn $150k–$185k + super

  • Rotating on-call roster (average 3 weeks per year) with additional penalties

  • Autonomous field service role with strong support from an experienced team

  • Sponsorship considered for suitable candidates

  • Adelaide / Brisbane location

The Role

This is a field service position working across a variety of industrial sites. You will be responsible for servicing, fault finding, breakdown repairs and preventative maintenance on overhead cranes, gantries, hoists and associated lifting equipment.

Duties include:


  • Electrical fault finding and diagnostics

  • Breakdown response and emergency repairs

  • Preventative maintenance and inspections

  • Testing and commissioning of crane systems

  • Working with PLCs, motors, contactors, VSDs, limit switches and control systems

  • Completing service reports and maintenance documentation

  • Travel is required across local, regional and occasionally interstate sites

  • Approximately 10–30% of work will involve travel outside the metro area

Requirements


  • Cert III Electrotechnology or equivalent

  • Electrical Licence or Restricted Electrical Licence

  • Experience within industrial maintenance, field service, automation, materials handling, conveyors, mining or heavy industry

  • PLC fault finding experience

Apply Now

If you're an experienced industrial electrician looking for a long-term role with strong earning potential, guaranteed overtime and the opportunity to develop specialist skills within the crane industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Maisy at maisy@maydaytechnical.com for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Day Shift - Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
The Company
This established heavy industrial company plays a key role in supplying essential materials into the construction, manufacturing and infrastructure sectors across NSW. Operating out of a large-scale processing facility in Blacktown, they offer stable long-term employment within a busy operation where maintenance reliability is critical to keeping production moving.
The site has a strong workshop culture with a large team of Fitters and Boilermakers onsite, supporting both workshop maintenance and production operations across the facility. It's a fast-paced environment with plenty happening day to day, a busy maintenance schedule, and a genuinely good atmosphere across the team.

Benefits

  • Permanent full-time role
  • 6-day work week: Monday – Saturday
  • Day Shift: Mon – Fri 5am–3:30pm | Sat 5am–11am
  • Strong safety culture and well-resourced maintenance team
  • Busy, team-oriented workshop and production environment
  • Blacktown location


Pay Rates & Shift Structure
Base Rate: $50.50 - $52.42 p/h + super
Annualised equivalent: $165,236 - $171,518 + super
Based on a 56-hour paid week, the standard working pattern is structured as:

  • First 38 hours paid at base rate
  • Next 18 hours paid at time and a half
  • Occasional longer Saturdays or Sunday shutdowns may push additional hours into double time; however, this is not included in the annualised calculations below

Annualised earnings are based on 48 weeks working the standard pattern plus 4 weeks annual leave paid at ordinary hours.

The Role
Working within the maintenance team, you'll be responsible for keeping heavy equipment and processing assets running reliably across a busy industrial site. The role offers exposure across both heavy fixed plant and mobile plant equipment within a workshop and production environment.
Day to day you will be involved in:

  • Maintenance and repairs on heavy fixed plant and mobile plant equipment
  • Fault finding, servicing and preventative maintenance on heavy machinery
  • Supporting shutdowns, breakdown response and reliability work
  • Working closely with operations teams to minimise downtime
  • Workshop-based repairs, fabrication support and onsite maintenance activities
    ​​​​​

Requirements

  • Trade qualification in Mechanical Fitting or similar
  • Experience within heavy industry, recycling, manufacturing or fixed plant environments
  • MIG or stick welding exposure highly regarded
  • High Risk tickets such as confined space, WAH, EWP, Forklift highly desirable

job.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
job.description:
Our client is a well-established Australian engineering and manufacturing business operating within the materials-handling sector is seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer for its Ingleburn team.

With a national footprint supporting major industrial, mining, manufacturing and infrastructure clients, the business designs, manufactures and delivers complex overhead-crane, lifting and materials-handling systems.

Benefits

  • Permanent, full-time position offering a highly competitive salary tailored to your specialist crane-design experience
  • Ownership of technically complex projects from initial design and calculations through to fabrication and delivery.
  • Work closely with experienced engineers, drafters and manufacturing teams in a practical, collaborative environment.

Key responsibilities –

  • Design complete overhead-crane arrangements and mechanical systems.
  • Develop mechanical layouts from customer specifications and project requirements.
  • Design and select end carriages, trolleys, hoisting mechanisms and travel systems.
  • Design or specify wheels, shafts, drums, sheaves, hooks and associated components.
  • Size and select motors, gearboxes, brakes and drive systems.
  • Complete mechanical, load, drive and fatigue calculations.
  • Conduct or review FEA and other engineering analysis.
  • Produce 3D models, detailed fabrication drawings and manufacturing documentation.
  • Prepare bills of materials, engineering reports and technical documentation.
  • Provide engineering support during fabrication, assembly, testing, installation and commissioning.
  • Investigate technical issues and implement practical design improvements.
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant crane and machinery standards.

Requirements –

  • A degree in Mechanical, Mechatronic or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • At least five years of direct, hands-on overhead-crane design experience.
  • Experience personally designing complete cranes or substantial crane components and systems.
  • An understanding of both the crane itself and its runway or supporting structure.
  • Strong mechanical calculations and component-selection experience.
  • Knowledge of AS 1418 or another internationally recognised crane-design code.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD and drafting software such as Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD, or comparable packages.
  • Experience with engineering calculation or FEA software.
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing drawings, bills of materials and design documentation.
  • Practical experience working with welded fabrication, machining and manufacturing teams.
